items.title: Hilton taps former Uber exec as CTO
items.snippet: Jeff Moore brings 20 years of experience in software engineering and operations to the role as Hilton looks to advance its AI goals. Hilton's addition of a CTO role to the leadership team comes as the hospitality company looks to enhance its AI-related capabilities. The company began looking for a CTO in May as Nassetta pointed to significant AI opportunities ahead for the company.

items.title: Adani Airports launches Swirl Transit Hotel at Navi Mumbai airport
items.snippet: Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL) has launched the 80-room Swirl Transit Hotel at Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA), introducing short-stay accommodation within Terminal 1 for transit passengers, travellers with early departures and late arrivals, and those with extended layovers.

items.title: Airlines Get More Time on Mumbai Airport Cuts — But the Move to Navi Mumbai Is Still Coming
items.snippet: Skift Take: Navi Mumbai says it has capacity, infrastructure, a transit hotel, a road network to reach the airport. What it needs now is international passengers.

items.title: Buying a PMS: lessons from an ex-hotelier who now works in hotel tech
items.snippet: A former hotelier turned Mews employee shares hard-won advice on PMS procurement: start with operational pain points, involve all staff, and use the switch as a chance to rethink workflows.

items.title: Marriott adds eight hotels to its portfolio in the Netherlands
items.snippet: Marriott International has signed an agreement with Dutch group Townhouse Hotels covering eight hotels and more than 700 rooms. The deal introduces the Series by Marriott brand to the Netherlands. It also allows the American group to establish a presence in Maastricht and Eindhoven.

items.title: Cygnett signs 114-key resort near Kainchi Dham
items.snippet: Cygnett Hotels & Resorts has signed a management agreement for a 114-key Cygnett Resort near Kainchi Dham in Nainital, Uttarakhand, expanding its presence in the state’s leisure and spiritual tourism market. The resort is being developed in partnership with Suri Developers and will be located in the Kumaon hills, with views of the Himalayan landscape.

items.title: Maharashtra Tourism, Agri Tourism ink MoU for skill training & entrepreneurship in Baramati
items.snippet: To give Maharashtra’s agri-tourism sector a more professional, skill-oriented and sustainable framework, the Maharashtra Tourism Department, and Agri Tourism Development Company Pvt. Ltd. (Agri Tourism India), led by agri-tourism expert Pandurang Taware, entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).

items.title: Celebrate Diwali amid Sri Lanka’s scenic landscapes with Heritance Hotels and Resorts
items.snippet: Heritance Hotels and Resorts is offering a series of Diwali experiences across its properties in Sri Lanka, combining festive dining and traditional celebrations with stays across the island’s Cultural Triangle, tea country and southern coast.

items.title: Brand USA appoints Caroline Beteta as Interim President & CEO
items.snippet: Brand USA, the destination marketing organization for the United States, today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Caroline Beteta Interim President & CEO, effective November 9.

items.title: McDonald's supplier HyFun plans Rs 2000 crore India IPO
items.snippet: HyFun Foods intends to raise up to 20 billion rupees through an IPO planned for late 2028. The company expects to initiate preparations for this IPO in mid-2027 as local demand increases. As frozen food becomes more popular, the firm anticipates significant revenue growth by expanding its capacity.
